title: Kitten with sparkly eyes
svg:
<svg viewBox="0 0 100 100" xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <!-- ears -->
  <polygon points="25,30 32,12 45,28" fill="#ff9a3c"/>
  <polygon points="75,30 68,12 55,28" fill="#ff9a3c"/>
  <polygon points="29,27 33,17 41,27" fill="#ffb3b3"/>
  <polygon points="71,27 67,17 59,27" fill="#ffb3b3"/>
  <!-- head -->
  <ellipse cx="50" cy="52" rx="30" ry="26" fill="#ffb347"/>
  <!-- cheeks -->
  <ellipse cx="36" cy="60" rx="7" ry="5" fill="#ff8fab"/>
  <ellipse cx="64" cy="60" rx="7" ry="5" fill="#ff8fab"/>
  <!-- eyes -->
  <ellipse cx="38" cy="46" rx="8" ry="9" fill="#3d5a80"/>
  <ellipse cx="62" cy="46" rx="8" ry="9" fill="#3d5a80"/>
  <circle cx="40" cy="43" r="3" fill="#ffffff"/>
  <circle cx="64" cy="43" r="3" fill="#ffffff"/>
  <circle cx="35" cy="49" r="1.5" fill="#ffffff"/>
  <circle cx="59" cy="49" r="1.5" fill="#ffffff"/>
  <circle cx="42" cy="48" r="1" fill="#a8dadc"/>
  <circle cx="66" cy="48" r="1" fill="#a8dadc"/>
  <!-- nose -->
  <polygon points="47,56 53,56 50,60" fill="#ff6b81"/>
  <!-- mouth -->
  <path d="M46,61 Q50,65 54,61" stroke="#e05a6a" stroke-width="1.5" fill="none" stroke-linecap="round"/>
  <!-- whiskers left -->
  <line x1="18" y1="54" x2="34" y2="56" stroke="#fff3b0" stroke-width="1.2" stroke-linecap="round"/>
  <line x1="18" y1="60" x2="34" y2="59" stroke="#fff3b0" stroke-width="1.2" stroke-linecap="round"/>
  <line x1="19" y1="66" x2="34" y2="62" stroke="#fff3b0" stroke-width="1.2" stroke-linecap="round"/>
  <!-- whiskers right -->
  <line x1="82" y1="54" x2="66" y2="56" stroke="#fff3b0" stroke-width="1.2" stroke-linecap="round"/>
  <line x1="82" y1="60" x2="66" y2="59" stroke="#fff3b0" stroke-width="1.2" stroke-linecap="round"/>
  <line x1="81" y1="66" x2="66" y2="62" stroke="#fff3b0" stroke-width="1.2" stroke-linecap="round"/>
  <!-- body -->
  <ellipse cx="50" cy="86" rx="22" ry="14" fill="#ffb347"/>
  <!-- paws -->
  <ellipse cx="38" cy="94" rx="7" ry="4" fill="#ffd9a0"/>
  <ellipse cx="62" cy="94" rx="7" ry="4" fill="#ffd9a0"/>
  <!-- tail -->
  <path d="M72,86 Q88,80 86,68 Q85,62 80,64" stroke="#ff9a3c" stroke-width="5" fill="none" stroke-linecap="round"/>
  <!-- forehead stripe -->
  <path d="M50,30 L50,38 M45,32 L45,37 M55,32 L55,37" stroke="#ff9a3c" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round"/>
</svg>
